5Agents choose fixed design tokens instead of hand-designing slides
6The output remains one self-contained HTML presentation

Template Surface Library

GLASS

Glass Panel

3

Motion Profiles

Different decks need different rhythm
Animation is a controlled deck token
Calm

Slow fade-and-blur entrance for serious reports.

Best for CFO, board, audit, and governance decks.

Editorial

Paper-like movement with subtle rotation and type-led rhythm.

Best for strategy stories, education, and thought leadership.

Kinetic

Fast energetic movement with stronger entrance and bounce.

Best for product demos, AI showcases, and launch moments.

Rule for agents

Do not describe animation in prose.
Choose animationProfile: executive, editorial, kinetic, calm, or none.
